$comment: Declarative map of CORE_RULES.md Two-Way sections to downstream rule audiences. Consumed by scripts/extract-core.js (which cli/scripts/sync-from-plugin.mjs runs to regenerate cli/src/hwip-core.generated.ts). Every `###` heading inside the scope MUST appear here — the extractor fails on an unclassified heading, so adding a new section to CORE_RULES.md forces an explicit decision. audiences: 'hook-driven' = agents with a Stop-equivalent hook (Cursor, Windsurf, Gemini, Codex, Copilot); 'rule-only' = agents without one (Cline, Aider). An empty audiences array is a deliberate exclusion — record why in `note`.

sections.heading: ### Notification discipline
sections.note: Replaced by the per-agent notify preambles in cli/src/templates.ts (HOOK_DRIVEN_NOTIFY / MANUAL_NOTIFY) — the discipline differs by hook presence.

sections.heading: ### Push Signal — steer the end-of-turn auto-push (Stop hook)
sections.note: ADR-0001: rule-only agents never get this (no hook to honor markers); hook-driven agents only once their hooks extract markers from the response — flip to ["hook-driven"] when per-agent marker adapters land. The section carries `hwip-branch` blocks the Claude Code SessionStart hook selects between by push dial; any future extraction must strip them. Because it is excluded, the included sections must not reference the Push Signal or the push-mode dial — the CLI harnesses receive neither, so such a sentence is an unfollowable instruction there (tests/test-extract-core.sh enforces this).
